content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Online travel marketplace for short-term stays; no lease-to-own financing or merchandise leasing like the target."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Home services matching marketplace charging pros for leads and memberships; does not finance consumer purchases of goods."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Corporate freight and utility bill payment and bank services for businesses; not consumer lease-to-own financing."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Buys and collects charged-off consumer debt; does not fund merchandise or lease goods to consumers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Independent seller marketplace for crafts and resale goods; consumers buy outright rather than lease."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate and government tenants; no consumer leasing of merchandise."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Franchisor of blue-collar staffing offices earning royalties; provides labor placement, not consumer financing."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Freight transportation and logistics for shippers using trucks and rail; unrelated to consumer lease-to-own."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage and risk consulting for businesses and individuals; no merchandise leasing or consumer credit."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Operates a hotel and apartment rentals with securities investing; hospitality and rent, not lease-to-own merchandise."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Lease-to-own access to furniture, electronics and appliances for credit-limited consumers via partner merchants, matching the target's model."}]}
